title: Disjointness of rescalings of smooth area preserving flows on surfaces
summary: We consider the problem of \emph{disjointness of rescalings} $(\varphi_{κt})_{t\in \mathbb{R}}$, $κ\in\mathbb{R}$ of a flow $(\varphi_{t})_{t\in \mathbb{R}}$ in the context of smooth flows preserving a smooth invariant measure, or, equivalently, locally Hamiltonian flows on compact orientable surfaces.
